mentions.name: Find a Conference
mentions.description: This web app helps people discover and evaluate cybersecurity conferences worth attending. It maintains a curated, human-verified list of conferences (with AI only used to assist data sourcing) and has reached MVP stage with early organic traffic.
mentions.problem: A friend needed a way to decide which cybersecurity conferences are worth going to.
mentions.audience: Infosec industry professionals deciding which cybersecurity conferences are worth attending
mentions.source_excerpt: A friend needed to decide which cybersecurity conferences are worth going to, so I started building Find a Conference (https://app.findaconference.net).
